cli_mapping: E7 native6 toengine7; E8 native0/1 toengine5/8; E6 beta128 only

e8_checks.scope: Signed9 cost ablation; range admission and full16 fallback removed. No wide-domain claim. E5minusE8 area is combined admission/widesupport cost, not isolated controller cost.

findings.issue: Hardcoded original a0 aggregate cannot represent accepted mixed original/retry routes.
findings.proposal: Add --resolved-route-acceptance. Verify the immutable manifest, its original acceptance pin, and exactly one accepted hardware.json per engine0..6. Allow a0 successes plus source-identical a1 retry directories; never overwrite original a0 evidence.

findings.issue: One a0 route template forces all engines to use the same route attempt.
findings.proposal: For each selected route, dispatch one-engine energy invocation with a route template whose engine token is retained and whose suffix matches that selected directory. Use unique child attempt per workload/engine or distinct attempt per grouping, because the child progress filename omits engine.

findings.issue: Child energy runners catch failures and return zero; process status alone does not establish closure.
findings.proposal: After each step require its exact expected acceptance/progress status, verify pins and required rows, and save the acceptance path+SHA in the sequence. For energy require progress status pass, zero failures and all four stage records plus each power_audit.json. Skip dependent stages when prerequisites fail; continue independent branches.

findings.issue: Final aggregation is invoked without its strict-complete option.
findings.proposal: Invoke --strict-complete and independently inspect output JSON. Keep primary comparison closure and original-E2 discrepancy resolution as distinct statuses: E7 acceptance cannot close the original E2 diagnostic.

findings.issue: Aggregator scans main/E7 only and excludes E8 native and route evidence.
findings.proposal: Add explicit separate E8 closure gate or a versioned ablation aggregator requiring pair/scalar stalled+unstalled native plus matched12ns route. Check legal_state_signed_bits9, mapping5/8→0/1, and94FF/1DSP. Do not add E8 to the full16 baseline set.

findings.issue: Latest route and latest power are selected independently, although every power audit binds a specific routed hardware file.
findings.proposal: For final selected comparison use the explicit resolved route manifest and require power.routed_hardware_file+SHA equal the chosen route. Snapshot all unselected attempts separately. Do not combine area from one route attempt with power from another without identifying both.

findings.issue: Standalone E8 native pins arithmetic sources through preparation but does not directly pin common job runner or installed glbl.v; parent sequence currently pins both.
findings.proposal: For standalone provenance completeness add these to a versioned E8 native runner, or record parent sequence provenance as required context. This does not invalidate the signed9 arithmetic source gate.

findings.issue: Docstring calls E8 an optimized LUT route although it is a one-DSP signed9 cost ablation.
findings.proposal: Correct the label in a future version; current accepted record fields correctly identify1DSP/signed9-only.
